court: In the High Court of Madras
judges_raw: (Before Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J. and G. Arul Murugan, J.)
advocates: For Petitioner: Mr. D. Sahithya, for Mr. M. Elango
prayer: Prayer: Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India for issuance of a writ of certiorarified Mandamus calling for the records to order passed by the respondent in Proceeding Ref. ROSLM/SALE/38/2024-25/KSK dated 13-5-2024 and quash the same.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J.:— The learned counsel for the petitioner seeks to withdraw the writ petition.

2. In view of the same, the writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn. There will be no order as to costs. Consequently, WMP Nos. 40572 and 16975 of 2024 are closed.
